Before we begin

A few things
you might ask.

What types of interiors do you work on?

Our services cover residential interiors, commercial spaces, turnkey solutions, and furniture and styling. Visit our Services page to explore each area.

How much will my interior project cost?

Cost depends on the size of your space, the work involved, materials and furniture selections. Share your requirements and approximate budget so the scope can be discussed before a quotation is prepared.

How long does an interior project take?

Timelines vary with design decisions, site conditions, material availability and the extent of the work. A project-specific schedule should be agreed after the scope is clear.

Can I start with just one room?

You can discuss a single-room refresh as well as a larger interior project. The right scope depends on what you would like to change and the support you need.

Do you work outside Bangalore?

Bangalore is our focus. For a property elsewhere, share its location and project requirements so availability and logistics can be discussed.

What should I prepare for a first conversation?

A floor plan or a few photos, your location, approximate budget, preferred timeline and any reference interiors are useful. You do not need to have every detail decided.
